'''2018 European MPC Results Martin den Boef LS He Is The Chosen One''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Martin den Boef]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Martin den Boef]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open He Is The Chosen One Boef LS 2018.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
